people.name: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
people.field: classical philologist and comparative linguist who specialised in Sanskrit, Celtic and Indo-European studies

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In his student days at the University of Leipzig

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In his student days at the University of Leipzig, he became friends with Friedrich Nietzsche.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: One of his teachers was Friedrich Wilhelm Ritschl.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In 1867 he obtained his PhD in classical philology

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: afterwards teaching at the Thomasschule of Leipzig (1867–1870).

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In the meantime, he completed his habilitation in Sanskrit and comparative linguistics at the university (1869).

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In 1870–71 he worked as a staff member of the India Office Library in London.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: Later on, he became a professor of comparative linguistics at Heidelberg University (1872)

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.role: professor of Sanskrit and director of the Indo-Europeanist institute
relations.evidence: In 1877 he returned to his alma mater in Leipzig as a professor of Sanskrit and director of the Indo-Europeanist institute.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In the academic year of 1895/96, he served as rector.

relations.subject: Friedrich Delitzsch
relations.evidence: Among his students were Friedrich Delitzsch

relations.subject: Anna Leonowens
relations.evidence: as well as Anna Leonowens who attended his Sanskrit lectures from 1897 to 1901.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.object: Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig
relations.evidence: In 1883 he was appointed a full member of the Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.object: Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities
relations.evidence: He became a corresponding member of the Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 1905.

relations.subject: Ernst Wilhelm Oskar Windisch
relations.evidence: In 1873 he married Berta Roscher, daughter of economist Wilhelm Roscher.

relations.subject: Hans Windisch
relations.evidence: The couple had five children, including the theologian Hans Windisch (1881–1935).
